verdict.rationale: Turso's docs explicitly advertise data residency control via BYOC (customer-owned S3/S3-express buckets) and per-database encryption with customer-held keys, directly addressing regional/residency choice for enterprise customers, and community mentions of 'certain regions' imply multi-region infrastructure exists. However, there's no first-party doc showing a simple region-selection flag/UI for standard (non-Enterprise) users creating a database, and no independent confirmation of how residency controls work in practice. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection mechanism in CLI/API docs for all tiers, independent/hands-on verification of residency guarantees.
